bites.title: Everything, together
bites.body: Your capstone: a sight-size master copy of a Bargue plate, built with the pipeline. Take your time. This is a multi-session painting, and Sensei will wait.

bites.title: Choose your plate
bites.body: Load a plate. Pick one that scares you a little.

bites.title: Block-in
bites.body: On the Copy layer: extremes, plumb lines, big shapes. Thirty light, straight marks. No details yet.

bites.title: Build the stack
bites.body: Add Flats (the big light and dark shapes), Shadow (Multiply) and Paintover on top, in that order.

bites.title: Mirror check
bites.body: Flip it ({key:mirror_canvas|M}). Fix what jumps out. Flip back.

bites.title: Save the master
bites.body: Save as .kra. Then incremental versions as you go.

bites.title: Finish and share
bites.body: Work until it's done. Export a PNG side by side with the plate, and a Recorder timelapse if you were recording. Bring it to class.

bites.title: 24 cleared
bites.body:
You set up a sight-size copy from a 160 year old plate, in a digital pipeline, with a trained hand.

That's the whole course. The Dojo is always open.
